items.name: Dolmen Open 2011
items.information: The registration is free.  Hotel accommodations can be found at [http://www.lalonguevue.fr/](http://www.lalonguevue.fr/).  People who come by train will have to take a train to "Angers", and then a bus to "Gennes".  They can also contact Gaël by calling the 06 59 07 81 10, or contact Philippe by calling the 06 12 66 62 44.
